tasks.short: Select and prepare competition medical equipment and medications.

steps.what: Assess the actual competition, athlete needs, site access and clinical coverage to select appropriate medical equipment and medications
Find and check the current equipment preparation, storage and medication-handling instructions for the selected kit
Physically inspect, prepare and pack the selected equipment and medications, checking actual quantities, expiry, integrity, storage and equipment function
Record and check actual packed contents, quantities, expiry checks and any unresolved preparation issue after inspecting the kit
Save the exact checked actual kit record v1 in the internal competition preparation folder

tasks.design: Configure {DOCS} filters for current preparation references by equipment or medication category and approved version. Selection, physical preparation and actual kit-record authorship stay with the physician; a planned kit list never becomes evidence that an item was packed or checked.
tasks.previous_blocker: Current preparation instructions may require repeated navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native document metadata and version filters can narrow the reference set.
tasks.still_hard: Clinical selection, medication handling and actual equipment readiness need physical checks.
tasks.human_edge: Anticipate the site's clinical needs and recognise unsafe equipment or stock.

ambition.what: No medication, prescribing or coverage authority changes.

tasks.altitude: Almost all work remains clinical and physical preparation.

reach.learn: How the medical kit fits the agreed emergency coverage plan

evidence.claim: Native document filters can shorten access to approved preparation instructions without automating physical kit work.

assumptions: Boundary includes selection, reference lookup, actual preparation and its record. Shares are provisional. Procurement, transport, dispensing and administration are distinct actions and receive no saving here.

The event organiser and existing care team supply actual site, sport, timing, coverage and known athlete needs; missing facts are clarified manually within s1. Procedure owners supply current equipment/medication category, version and approved handling instructions, checked in s2.
The physician produces actual quantities, expiry/integrity/function findings and packed contents in s3-s4; selected contents are not actual inventory. No scanning or sensor feed is assumed.
The ordinary save has no saving, edits void approval and existing runtime is excluded.
unknowns: Current reference organisation and who actually performs kit preparation
research_questions: How much preparation reference searching is repetitive rather than clinical interpretation?

already_counted.description: Capture and check actual kit contents

incremental.description: Maintain preparation-reference links and version filters

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central 10 reference hours at 25% reduction less 0.5 upkeep = 2. Low assumes instructions are already directly available; physical selection, preparation and actual record writing do not shrink.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Conduct sports-injury prevention or treatment research.

steps.what: Develop the sports-injury research question and scientifically appropriate protocol, outcomes and explicit analysis plan within the required approved study scope
outputs: authorised study protocol and analysis plan

steps.what: Conduct the authorised sports-injury study procedures and capture actual observations, outcomes, deviations and required participant permissions
inputs: authorised study protocol and analysis plan

steps.what: Apply the explicit analysis plan to actual checked study data, inspect missingness and model diagnostics and interpret the findings
inputs: authorised study protocol and analysis plan

steps.what: Write and check the actual research findings and limitations, using checked result tables, and approve the exact report v1, internal storage and study-team recipient
Save the exact approved research report v1 to the internal study folder
Send the exact approved research report v1 to the approved internal study-team recipient

tasks.design: Configure saved explicit analysis operations in the research/statistics system in {OTHER} and result-table insertion into {DOCS}. The physician conducts the authorised study, captures actual observations and retains scientific interpretation and report meaning; no model chooses methods or writes unsupported conclusions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated table production and report layout can be manual despite an explicit analysis plan.
tasks.enabler_now: Native statistical workflows and document table links can repeat specified operations.
tasks.still_hard: Study validity, participant care, missingness, confounding and causal interpretation require scientific judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise when the data cannot support a prevention or treatment claim.

ambition.what: No new study, clinical or publication authority.

tasks.altitude: Less repeat analysis execution and table layout; research decisions and actual study work stay whole.

reach.learn: Outcome measurement and limits of observational treatment comparisons

evidence.claim: Native statistical workflows can repeat an explicit analysis plan and insert checked result tables into documents.

assumptions: Boundary includes the physician's research design, authorised conduct, actual capture, analysis and internal findings report. Institutional/ethics approval and participant permission must actually be obtained before relevant study activity; they are not generated by this design or credited as saved. Shares are provisional.

The physician/study team produces actual participant study IDs, observation dates, exposure or intervention, outcomes, units, missingness and deviations under the protocol in s2. Missing records are resolved manually; a planned visit or intervention is not an actual observation.

s1 supplies explicit variable definitions, inclusion rules and planned calculations; s3 uses native tools first, retaining diagnostics, sensitivity decisions and interpretation. Other researchers' collection effort is unchanged, not transferred free work.

s4 saves time only on table insertion and layout; the physician authors conclusions and checks final scientific meaning and disclosure. Edits void approvals. Ordinary save, internal send and existing runtime earn no saving. Journal submission or clinical deployment is separate.
unknowns: Existing research-data structure and native analysis workflow coverage
research_questions: Which repeated table operations can be reproduced independently from the checked analysis plan?

already_counted.description: Inspect data exceptions, diagnostics and scientific interpretation
Author and check actual findings and disclosure

incremental.description: Maintain analysis reproducibility checks and document table mappings

approvals.approved_version: research report package v1: report and internal folder
research report package v1: report and study-team recipient

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central 8 repeat-analysis plus 3.6 table/layout points less 1 upkeep = 10.6. Low assumes heterogeneous studies and difficult missing data leave most analysis manual; research design, conduct, capture and scientific interpretation keep their effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Advise athletes about substances and drug-testing results.

steps.what: Obtain and clarify the athlete's actual medication, herbal remedy and supplement use, product details, timing and testing context
Look up and verify current authoritative substance and testing references for the actual ingredients, route, timing and sport context
outputs: checked relevant source passages and uncertainties

steps.what: Judge the implications and advise the athlete about possible testing effects, uncertainties and appropriate specialist referral without promising a negative test
inputs: checked relevant source passages and uncertainties

steps.what: Record and check the actual substance facts, advice, uncertainty and agreed next steps in the clinical note
Save the exact checked clinical advice note v1 in the correct athlete record

tasks.design: Configure current-source filters in the clinician reference tools and chart in {OTHER}, linking to approved passages in {DOCS}. The physician checks actual product facts and gives the advice; the chart reuses visit headers only, while actual advice and uncertainty are entered and checked by the physician.
tasks.previous_blocker: Current substance references can require repeated navigation across categories.
tasks.enabler_now: Native source filters and visit-header reuse can narrow the clerical work.
tasks.still_hard: Undeclared ingredients, contamination and context-specific testing effects cannot be ruled out from a product name.
tasks.human_edge: Explain uncertainty and avoid false reassurance about a testing outcome.

ambition.what: No automatic drug-testing clearance or medical decision.

tasks.altitude: Source access is shorter; the clinical conversation and judgement remain.

reach.learn: Ingredient, route and formulation distinctions relevant to reliable reference checking

evidence.claim: Native current-source filtering and visit-header reuse can support clinician lookup and documentation without deciding advice.

assumptions: Boundary includes actual history, lookup, advice and its note. It excludes a new prescribing change or formal testing clearance; any referral send remains its own authorised action. Shares are provisional.

The athlete and actual labels supply product/ingredient, dose, route and timing, clarified by the physician in s1. Missing ingredients or unreliable labels remain explicit uncertainty, not model-inferred facts.

The clinical source owner supplies reference version/effective date, substance, route, sport/testing scope and source passages. Missing structured fields are checked by reading the actual source in s2. {OTHER} means clinician reference resources and the clinical record.

s4 only saves header re-entry; actual advice capture and checking remain. Native configuration comes first, no model medical inference. Ordinary save is unchanged, edits void approval and runtime earns no saving.
unknowns: Current authoritative-reference access and source metadata
research_questions: Can current reference filters narrow the source set without hiding relevant uncertainty?

already_counted.description: Check actual source applicability and uncertainties
Capture and check actual advice note

incremental.description: Maintain current-source links and clinical note headers

approvals.approved_version: advice note v1 and athlete record

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central 7 lookup plus 1.9 header-entry points less 1 upkeep = 7.9. Low assumes difficult ingredients need mostly manual reference work; history, advice and substantive note capture retain full effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Assess the athlete's actual condition, goals, current capacity, contraindications and off-season needs
Select the actual exercise programme, dose, progression, restrictions, stop criteria and review timing for this athlete
Prepare the written exercise programme from the selected instruction entries and exact physician-specified dose, progression and restrictions
Review and approve the exact completed exercise prescription v1 for patient identity, clinical suitability, instruction meaning, progression, restrictions and intended destinations
Commit the exact approved exercise prescription v1 to the correct internal clinical record
Explain the prescribed exercises, restrictions and stop criteria to the athlete and check understanding
outputs: actual exercise explanation and understanding check

steps.what: Release the exact approved exercise prescription v1 to the approved athlete recipient
inputs: actual exercise explanation and understanding check

tasks.design: Configure the clinical exercise-prescription system in {OTHER} to assemble selected approved instruction entries and exact physician-entered programme parameters. The physician assesses, selects and reviews the complete prescription, commits it separately and explains it personally before releasing that approved version to the athlete; fixed instruction assembly needs no model.
tasks.previous_blocker: Selected instructions and exact programme parameters are repeatedly copied into patient documents.
tasks.enabler_now: Native exercise libraries and document templates can merge explicitly selected entries.
tasks.still_hard: Individual suitability, progression and safe response to symptoms require clinical judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Fit the programme to the athlete's real capacity and understanding.

ambition.what: No automated clinical selection or prescribing authority.

tasks.altitude: Less prescription assembly; assessment, selection and explanation remain whole.

reach.learn: How prescribed progression and stop criteria are applied during actual practice

evidence.claim: Native exercise libraries and document templates can assemble explicitly selected instructions and clinician-entered parameters.

assumptions: Boundary includes assessment, programme design, written prescription, record commit, explanation and athlete release. Shares are provisional. Actual later exercise performance and monitoring are separate work, not assumed completion.

The physician produces actual condition, goals, capacity and restrictions in s1, then explicit exercise IDs, dose, frequency, progression, stop criteria and review timing in s2. Library owners provide approved instruction text and versions; missing or bespoke instructions are written manually within s2-s3.

s3 copies only specified content; it never chooses intensity, substitutes exercises or infers restrictions. {OTHER} means clinical record and exercise-prescription tools. Native assembly is tested before custom code.

s4 approves the final document and both destinations. Any change after explanation returns the revised version for clinical review and voids prior approvals. Record commit, release and runtime earn no saving.
unknowns: Approved exercise-library coverage and native document capability
research_questions: Which prescription content is selected instruction reuse versus new clinical design?

already_counted.description: Check and correct assembled prescription instructions
Review completed prescription meaning and suitability

incremental.description: Maintain approved instruction versions and parameter mapping checks

approvals.approved_version: exercise prescription package v1: clinical record payload
exercise prescription package v1: athlete document and recipient

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central 20 assembly hours at 55% reduction less 0.8 upkeep = 10.2. Low assumes bespoke programmes and instruction gaps leave most writing manual; assessment, clinical selection, final review and explanation keep full effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Clinical and research decisions remain with the physician; repeat lookup, table layout and selected-instruction assembly can shrink.
reach: Athletic Trainers: align kit readiness with competition coverage
Physical Therapists: connect prescribed exercise parameters with actual practice
skills_to_grow: Native clinical instruction assembly and version control
role.ambitious_version: A sports medicine physician who spends less time repeating clerical preparation while maintaining actual assessment, advice and safe clinical decisions.
